newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Super Coffee unit buys beverage company.
newsitem.headline: Super Coffee unit buys beverage company.

text.p: Super Coffee Manufacturing Ltd said on Monday its Malaysian unit, Super Food Technology Sdn Bhd (SFT), had agreed to buy a stake in a canned drinks company.
It said in a statement SFT had entered a subscription agreement with Nyen Heng Food Processing & Packaging Sdn Bhd for 4.92 million new ordinary shares of Ringgit 1.00 each in the Malaysian company.
Nyen Heng has an authorised capital of ringgit 5.0 million divided into five million shares of ringgit 1.00 each and a paid-up capital of ringgit 1.23 million.
It will increase its authorised capital to ringgit 10 million. SFT will then subscribe for 80 percent of the enlarged capital of ringgit 6.15 million.
The purchase depends on Nyen Heng obtaining a manufacturing licence from the Malaysian Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), and the subscription being approbed by MITI.
Super Coffee said the acquisition of a controlling interest in Nyen Heng wull strengthen the company's diversification into the canned drinks sector of the beverage industry.
